description: This file defines the Aws\Sqs\SqsClient class, a specialized client for interacting with Amazon SQS. It includes methods for queue URL to ARN conversion, MD5 checksum calculations for message validation, and a middleware for validating message MD5s during message reception.

classes.name: SqsClient
classes.description: A client class for Amazon SQS providing methods to manage queues and validate message integrity, extending the base AwsClient.

methods.name: getQueueArn
methods.description: Converts a queue URL into its corresponding ARN format, with special handling for FIFO queues.

methods.name: calculateMessageAttributesMd5
methods.description: Calculates the MD5 hash of message attributes to verify message integrity.

methods.name: calculateBodyMd5
methods.description: Calculates the MD5 hash of a message body.

methods.name: getEncodedStringPiece
methods.description: Encodes a string piece with its length in a specific format for MD5 calculation.

methods.name: getEncodedBinaryPiece
methods.description: Encodes binary data with length prefix for MD5 calculation.

methods.name: getFourBytePieceLength
methods.description: Returns the four-byte length prefix of a given piece.

methods.name: validateMd5
methods.description: Creates a middleware function to validate received message MD5 hashes for integrity checks.
